Masterclasses / Online Beading Class

Online Beading Class

Beading materials, random, clustered, straight-line and twisted beading, ombre effects, dress-tip beading, and rivet machine technique.

SELF-PACED MODULES · All levels

A closer look
at the craft.

Beading turns a simple garment into something people stop and stare at. In this class you will learn beading materials and several beading patterns, including random, clustered and twisted styles, plus how to use a rivet machine like a pro. Perfect for anyone who wants to add a signature finish to their work.

What you’ll explore

  • Beading materials
  • Random
  • Clustered
  • Straight-line and twisted beading
  • Ombre effects
  • Dress-tip beading
  • And rivet machine technique

Before you begin

Ask Gracy to confirm your starting skill level, required materials, class dates, delivery format and resource access. Have your measurements, drafting supplies and appropriate equipment ready.

Enrolment is handled through the academy’s existing Selar checkout or directly with Gracy. Card details are never collected on this website.
